title: Conditional κ = 0.001674097969905390: an attaining T37 construction and fixed R480 owner optimum
body:
The seven-slot k8 R480 word has an exact owner optimum across all positive replica counts. This package proves that bound and gives a physical 37-replica construction that attains it, with conditional **κ = 0.001674097969905390**. It changes only the owner assignment and its finite admission. The local word, bit supplier, and selected-result pointers are unchanged.

The signed bin inequality covers all 1,163 whole-helper patterns. Two exact rational engines certify its moment support over the complete root interval `[0.001676905273619680861300, 0.001676905273619680861301]`. Equality forces a multiple of 37 replicas. An integer pattern-flow certificate expands into 159,840 literal roles in 333 complete calls. The independent audit reconstructs source-event windows, 73-axis charts, and disjoint pending children on each physical family.

The full finite invoice charges 1024 complex prefix bits: the actual bound is 775. Its physical row coefficient is 17,495, below 20,161. The complete deficit stays 320 per replica; the gain changes the child-rank distribution. The complete native/bit composition passes all 47 outer inequalities. This is the maximum grid value for the fixed word, capacity inventory, and outer recipe. A changed local word or another assembly recipe lies outside that ceiling.

Reproduce from this branch with a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -B research/r480-owner-optimum/check.py --work /tmp/r480-owner-check
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_R480_ALL_REPLICA_OPTIMUM_AND_ATTAINING_CONSTRUCTION 0.00167409796990539
```

The command needs no solver, network, or third-party Python package. It passed in the author worktree and in a separate coordinator replay. Checks include 18 certificate CLI controls, 15 controller mutations, 7 independent owner controls, 69 admission controls, and 12 bit controls. A separate actual-CLI phase-axis collision is rejected at the intended predicate. `evidence/` contains the exact receipts. `git diff --check` passed. The shared repository-wide baseline `make verify` was still running at handoff; its result is separate from these focused passes.

The experimental base is `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`. The local word is pinned to PR1074 `052afc128954f7b6a2b3c409eb4d72248e4020f2`. A concurrent sprint worker rebuilt the unchanged local chain, native scalar program, wrappers, and all 2,896 exact phase edges; this package retains those source-bound inputs and command receipts. The owner replay consumes that local admission. The cited PR589 bit circuit is not rebuilt here; its full profile and exceptional-residue surcharge are repriced.

At the final submission refresh, main `ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08` selects PR1094 at κ `0.001672660197076918`. This proposal is about 0.08596 percent higher. The complex side remains binding. PR1121 (`61e816c29165a94f6cfc57d9e195063a5b027bc2`, reported κ `0.001672965558289236`) changes the local word and is outside this theorem. `evidence/OVERLAP.json` records the compared heads.

Concurrent #1131 (`0640fa55`) independently attains the same κ and fixed-inventory grid ceiling with a different 333-call order and owner flow. We rebuilt its frozen flow, reran its price certificate, and checked its owners with our independent auditor; those focused checks pass. Its full cold-replay driver complements our interval-wide root certificate and explicit disjoint-pending-axis check.

Credit: Chafik Boukhalfa's PR795 signed prices; the PR890/PR942 all-replica proof method; Hao Yan's owner and source-event machinery; Jeremy Kothe's PR1074/1018 local word and its ancestry, including Rohan Arun's PR987; the PR1034 scoped old-catalogue bound; PR1069's independent pricing audit; and Josie Elliston's PR1091 pending-axis check. Preserved notices, exact source pins, and explicit derived-code diffs are included. New work is by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0.

The full tight-face chronology LP timed out. Restriction to the nine-pattern optimal basis gave the exact integer flow. The timeout is not an impossibility result. The optimum follows from the proved bound and the attaining construction, not from solver optimality. All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer, and bit H1-H5 obligations remain inherited. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a full formalization, or a measured runtime gain.
